Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.

Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Raipur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow positions at NIT Raipur is 09-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech./MCA or B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with a qualified GATE/NET in relevant fields and a minimum of 60% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow positions will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.

faq.question: Q9. What is the interview date for the Junior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Research Fellow positions is scheduled to be held on 14-09-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a B.E./B.Tech. degree apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a B.E./B.Tech. degree are eligible if they have also qualified GATE/NET in the specified disciplines and meet the minimum aggregate marks criteria.
